description: Main entry point for a Probot application handling GitHub repository events, comments, and communication with a Flask backend for bug localization and analysis.

methods.name: replyWithError
methods.description: Sends an error message as a comment on a GitHub issue.

methods.name: getInitializationComment
methods.description: Generates the initial comment message when the bot joins a repository.

methods.name: getCompletionComment
methods.description: Generates a completion message indicating setup is finished.
